core_mechanism: Agents deposit pheromone on paths proportional to solution quality. Pheromone evaporates over time. Future agents probabilistically choose paths based on pheromone intensity, creating positive feedback for good solutions.
Particles move through solution space with velocity influenced by personal best position and global/neighborhood best position. Social and cognitive components balance exploration and exploitation.

Population of candidate solutions evolves through selection (fitness-proportional survival), crossover (recombination of parent solutions), and mutation (random perturbation). Fittest individuals are more likely to reproduce.

biological_source: Genetic evolution with emphasis on differential mutation
core_mechanism: Mutation creates trial vectors by adding weighted difference of randomly selected population members to a base vector. Crossover mixes trial with target. Selection keeps better of trial/target.
Three bee roles: employed bees exploit known food sources, onlooker bees choose sources based on quality reports (waggle dance), scout bees abandon poor sources and explore randomly.

Fireflies are attracted to brighter (fitter) fireflies. Attraction strength decreases with distance (light absorption). Less bright fireflies move toward brighter ones. Random movement when no brighter neighbor.
Virtual bats fly with varying frequency, velocity, and loudness. Frequency controls search step size. Loudness decreases and pulse emission rate increases as bat converges on prey (solution).

Cuckoos lay eggs (solutions) in host nests. If discovered (probability pa), host abandons nest and builds new one (random solution). Best nests carry over. Levy flights provide efficient random search.

Wolf hierarchy: alpha (best solution), beta (second best), delta (third best), omega (rest). Hunting phases: encircling prey, hunting (position update toward alpha/beta/delta), attacking (exploitation via shrinking encirclement).

Whales encircle prey and create shrinking circles or spiral-shaped paths (bubble-net). Algorithm alternates between encircling best solution (shrinking circle) and spiral position update. Random whale chosen for exploration.

Clonal selection: antibodies (solutions) that recognize antigens (problems) are cloned proportionally to affinity. Clones undergo hypermutation (inversely proportional to affinity). Negative selection removes self-reactive antibodies.
